}}'''Deepe Bhadar''' was an [[Andor]]an [[Asha'man]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Deepe Bhadar|Deepe}}

==Appearance==
Deepe had a flat face, long black hair and a missing leg.{{ref/book|13|28}}

==History==
He was from [[Andor]].

==Activities==
Deepe was one of the only three full Asha'man who were in [[Maradon]] with [[Lord]] [[Rodel Ituralde]]. He was the leader of the group of a hundred Asha'man, Dedicated and Soldiers sent to [[Saldaea]] by Rand (so probably he was the strongest among them). He helped defend [[Maradon]] against the [[Shadowspawn]] army.{{ref/book|13|28}} He was standing with Ituralde on Maradon's wall when part of the wall was destroyed by enemy [[Dreadlord]]s. Deepe was knocked unconscious and lost his lower right leg in the explosion but was saved by Ituralde and Healed later by [[Antail]]. {{ref||Deepe}}

Deepe rides with Lan, cutting enemy channelers weaves while fighting in [[Shienar]] in the [[Last Battle]].

== Death ==
Deepe spots [[Mazrim Taim]] and wants to challenge him, but is killed by the other man before he can try. Lan caught the sight of his corpse, mangled and lying in pieces.{{ref/book|14|16}}

== Trivia ==
* Deepe Bhadar is named for Deep Bhandari, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
